title: Let's Build a Redstone Shop
description:
I've almost wrapped up another semester of my engineering degree and I'm in the mood for some redstone engineering. In this video we focus on my perspective as I explore the problem of partially filling shulker box slots for a shop display and we learn how to tackle complex redstone problems in minecraft like a real engineer.
